title: Saudi employee arrested for allegedly bugging OpenAI office in San Francisco
script:
A Saudi national was arrested for allegedly bugging the OpenAI office in San Francisco.
The suspect allegedly planted hidden surveillance devices to monitor internal activities at the headquarters.
Federal agents from the FBI took the employee into custody after the equipment discovery.
The individual worked directly for OpenAI inside their California offices.
Prosecutors allege the suspect intended to exfiltrate proprietary data from the AI developer.
This security breach is now under active investigation by federal authorities.
Do you feel safe with your data inside big AI labs?
